summary.intent: Work through the local NEXT-WORK plan for the Callisto release tool (cleanup, test debt, SYS-RETRY, SYS-NAPI, derive.rs refactor), then figure out what remains before v1 and fix the fixed-group GitHub release notes bug.
summary.outcome: Opened PRs for W2 SYS-RETRY (#202), W1 mixed-routing test (#203), W0 docs refresh (#204), a stacked R5a/R5b/SYS-NAPI set (#205, #206, #208, stack #207), R3 derive.rs split, a spec-drift fix (#346) and a fixed-group release-notes union fix; each had `just ci` passing. Closed the mistaken PR #201 and moved the plan to a git-excluded local file. Real-tool proof, W0 branch deletion and several user decisions remain open.

repo: Tracking and handoff plans (NEXT-WORK.md) must stay local: they live at .claude/plans/ and are excluded via .git/info/exclude, never in a commit or PR.

Release selection used to treat a tag on HEAD as 'released'. SYS-RETRY fix: a package tagged at HEAD now has all operations observed (registry, tag, GitHub release) and stays selected until each is satisfied, while a tag on an older commit settles the version without contacting providers.
Release e2e harness fakes git, gh, cargo and the registry; its effects log now records read-only calls, so no-op assertions compare mutating calls only.

Generated workflow napi roster: the plan job's jq iterates `.artifactSlots[]`, but the intent omits that field when empty; `callisto matrix` fails with E204 for unrelated addons without a valid crate. The fix asks `matrix` per intent package and placement reads the plan job's `napi_dirs` output.
macOS bash lacks `mapfile`, so templates that run in tests use portable while-read loops.
Bare package names are now E317 and the colon form is E316; most spec drift came from specs still describing bare names resolving or giving E103.
Changeset entries naming a bare shared name fail `version` with E103, but `status` only reports an error diagnostic and exits 0.
Pre mode still refreshes and stages lockfiles/manifests; only consumption of changesets is skipped. `pre.json` lives in the configured changesets dir.
Diagnostic names on the wire are kebab-case (e.g. `range-not-round-trippable`).

A GitHub release for a fixed group takes notes only from the owning package's changelog section. Changes recorded under a non-owner member (and boilerplate like 'Released together with the lockstep group') leave the notes empty. Fix: union all members' sections, drop boilerplate, dedupe, and prefix entries from other members with the package name.
Configured changelog paths are relative to the package directory; fixed-group config needs a `name`.
Snapshot-first (insta) then move-only commits works for the derive.rs and init.rs refactors; mutation checks confirm the snapshots catch regressions.

code.finding: Release notes were derived from only the owner package's changelog section; now extended to merge fixed-group members' sections.
Long derive function split into stage functions with `uploads_by_package` moved into `OpIndex`; `add_forge_releases` now looks up fixed-group mates and their changelogs for notes.
Tag inspection errored on multi-paragraph or signed tag messages; fixed to read only the object type, as the spec says annotation text is never compared.

workflow: Prove with the real tool, not fakes: fake tools hid the earlier gh bug and layered PRs only compiled.
Write the failing reproduction first, then fix; mutation-test new tests (revert source to confirm they fail) when they pass on the first run.
Read the log's own `exit=` line for background `just ci`; the task-notification only reports that the wrapper script exited.
The sandbox rejects inline env, heredoc and some git-mentioning scripts, so use script files, Write and Edit instead; edits are limited to the current worktree.
Use separate worktrees per lane and run `just ci` one at a time; `gh stack` links stacked PRs natively.
Get an independent subagent review of the riskiest PR (#202), and fan out spec-drift checks across spec files to parallel agents.
Subagents sharing a /tmp scratch dir clobbered each other (one deleted another's directory); give each agent its own scratch path.
Confirm before outward-facing or irreversible actions such as deleting branches.

friction: Plan file was only on PR #201, which was opened by mistake; the user objected and the PR was closed.
Sandbox restrictions on inline env, heredocs and git-containing commands forced script-file workarounds.
Background sessions could not edit the shared checkout's .claude/plans/NEXT-WORK.md to record PR status.
Three existing tests assumed 'tag on HEAD means released' and had to be rewritten after the SYS-RETRY fix.
CI failures along the way: init tests, local.rs tests, a stray blank line in R5a.
The fixture for the napi tests took several rounds to match E204, intent shape and dry-run report envelope.
Parallel subagents collided on scratch directories, and one ran commands inside the worktree.
open_items: Decision D01 blocks SYS-MATURIN and W9; W10 needs two decisions (graph edges for distinct target declarations, Python dev group cascade).
W1 real-service credential check needs a decision on where it runs in CI; W11 needs credentials and an approved run.
W0 branch cleanup is not done: about 35 local branches (squash-merged) and remote branches docs/next-work-plan, docs/spec-rewrite, fix/native-resolution await per-branch approval.
#204 still lists SYS-RETRY/T08-RETRY and needs a follow-up edit once #202 merges.
Real `gh`, `cargo` and registry reads for SYS-RETRY remain unproven; #202 has had an independent review but its findings were still being worked.
Lanes B (done), C (W3 SYS-PYFILES/PYROUTES/W4), D SYS-BARRIER and F (R1 walk.rs::build) are not started; W9 waits on W2 and R1.

Pre-v1 list: real end-to-end registry run, a stability page pinning one-way doors, and decisions on ADR 12, npm OIDC, private-root exclusion, and shared fixed-group tag/title and private PyPI indexes.
The fixed-group release still has no title and one release per package, a separate design gap.

Known gaps: private root package.json listed as a package, the #290 guard's history-cap and merge-only-edit cases need re-checking, plus small cleanup (README/SECURITY pre-v1 wording, macos-13 runner, proto/callisto.toml platforms, immutable releases, manual first publish docs).
Spec-drift pass left unverified: live npm/cargo/twine/gh behavior, E320 version-commit walk, PyPI digest matching, interactive `add` wizard.
